import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem intersection_is_greatest_lower_bound {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F]
  [Module F V] {ι : Type*} (u : ι → Submodule F V) :
  (∀ x : V, x ∈ (⨅ i, u i) ↔ ∀ i, x ∈ u i) ∧
    (∀ W : Submodule F V, W ≤ ⨅ i, u i ↔ ∀ i, W ≤ u i) := by
  first
  | exact Submodule.mem_iInf
  | exact le_iInf_iff
  | simp only [Submodule.mem_iInf, le_iInf_iff]
  | intro h
    first
    | exact Submodule.mem_iInf.mp h
    | exact Submodule.mem_iInf.mpr h
    | exact le_iInf_iff.mp h
    | exact le_iInf_iff.mpr h
  | aesop
  simp_all [Submodule.mem_iInf, le_iInf_iff]
